**Deadhead — Gold Line play surface** (Director notes).

World Scene inject (flag `goldLineScene`) creates **Scenes → Deadhead → Gold Line** on first GM load of a **new** world only.

**Locked architecture (new worlds):**
- **Level background** = interior motion MP4 (`map-gold-line-interior-loop.mp4`), video loop + autoplay.
- **ONE Tile** = roofs (`goldLineRoofs`): `map-gold-line-roofs-loop.mp4`, 6472×958, start **x=0 y=0 elev=1**, locked, occlusion **NONE**.
- No interior motion tile. No second background. Inject deletes leftover `goldLineInterior` tiles.

`resolveSrc`: loop.mp4 → loop.webm → still.webp. Stills are a valid playable layout if a loop is missing.

**Director — hide roofs:** when the crew goes **inside**, hide **Roofs** (Tiles layer → eye / right-click Hide). Unhide for the roof Recall bail. Occlusion stays off.

**Live worlds are sacred.** If a scene already has flag `goldLineScene`, the module returns immediately — it never rewrites background, tiles, levels, walls, lights, or dimensions. `{ force: true }` is GM-opt-in only and overwrites the live scene; do not run it on a dressed map.

**Plate:** 6472 × 958. **Grid:** 208 px = 5 ft. Art has **no baked grid**.

**Lock:** CyberMaps Hammerhead dual stitch. Do not drop a generated train.

SoR: `docs/directors/runs/deadhead/DEADHEAD-GOLD-LINE.md`.

text.markdown:
Design truth is still **5 cars**: cab · courier · security · passenger · tail. The shipped plate is **2 × 3 Hammerhead chambers**, left → right = aft → forward (nose right). Crew boards **aft** and works **upstream** (rightward).

| Plate zone (L→R) | Hammerhead part | Deadhead beat |
|---|---|---|
| **L1** | Left aft cargo | **TAIL** — board here (drone sling) |
| **L2** | Left connector | **PASSENGER** — civilian clutter / Enforcers |
| **L3** | Left forward + cab | **SECURITY** — treat mid cab as sealed ARG booth / Lt nest; play the cargo bay |
| *(coupler)* | Synthetic join | Non-walkable or Maglock gangway (Director call) |
| **R1** | Right aft cargo | **COURIER** — sealed capsule stacks |
| **R2** | Right connector | Transfer / Wire closet (cams/doors node) |
| **R3** | Right forward + cab | **CAB** — drive end; Trace host fiction |

**Wire on this plate:** Track 1 cams/doors **R2**; Track 2 capsule lock **R1** + Watchdog ICE.

If you need a clean sixth room, split R2 as its own Wire chase between courier and cab. Mid-consist double-cab (L3) is the Hammerhead artifact — narrate sealed engineering rather than a second drive cab.

Players still learn the exact capsule car only on a **great success** in discovery; otherwise they search.
